notes: Starting 8 as posted: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Tatooine (Coruscant printing, posted 'Tattoine (new)'), Tatooine: Cantina (Light), Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (posted 'Tattoine DB'), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire, Insurrection & •Aim High, Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60.

Format Premiere - Coruscant: the description calls it the deck 'with new Coruscant' and it runs the Coruscant combo Effects (Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire, Insurrection & •Aim High, Your Insight Serves You Well & •Staging Areas), All Wings Report In & •Darklighter Spin, Murr Danod and the Coruscant-set Tatooine.

'Green 1' and 'Other 1' are section headers (a one-card section holding X-wing Laser Cannon, and the Admiral's Order section holding I'll Take The Leader), not cards; with them read as headers the list totals 60.

Posted 'Chewie, Bodyguard' dested Chewbacca, Protector: the strategy says Chewie cancels the game text of the power-2 Televan Koreyy, which is Chewbacca, Protector's text (cancel game text of an opponent's character of power < 4).

Posted 'Ralltiir FC' dested Ralltiir Freighter Captain; 'Naked 3PO' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Artoo & 3PO' Artoo & Threepio; 'Artoo, I`ve got a BAD feelings...' Artoo, I Have A Bad Feeling About This; 'I`ve got a BAD feelings...' I've Got A Bad Feeling About This; 'Mur Danod' Murr Danod; 'Menades Fades' Menace Fades; 'Tat. Celeberation' Tatooine Celebration.

Combo shorthands dested to the combo cards: 'Staging Areas / YISYW' Your Insight Serves You Well & •Staging Areas; 'Houjix / OON' Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'OOC / TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Sorry / BP' Sorry About The Mess & •Blaster Proficiency; 'Shocking / Grimtash' Shocking Information & •Grimtaash; 'Darklighter Spin / All Wings Report In' All Wings Report In & •Darklighter Spin.
The strategy mentions 'four Saber Lukes' but the list has Luke With Lightsaber x2; kept as published.
